note: Components for the circuit lab: every part an electronics / electrical-engineering class uses, with pins, how to simulate it, how it should look in 3D, and what it teaches. level 1 = first weeks, 2 = core course, 3 = advanced. See knowledge/circuit-lab.md. Boards carry `runtime`: chip = the real chip emulated in the browser; server = real firmware in an emulator on our server with pins bridged over WebSocket; code = the student's code runs in the browser against a model of the board.

parts.look: bench box with a seven-segment frequency readout and a BNC input
parts.teach: frequency vs period, gate time and resolution, trigger level and hysteresis

parts.name: Spectrum analyzer
parts.sim: FFT of the simulated waveform up to 1 MHz (Hann window, RBW = 1.5·fs/N, boxcar anti-alias); RF carriers 1 MHz–3.2 GHz from the link-budget model over a −135 dBm/100 Hz floor; +20 dBm max
parts.look: dark bench box with a spectrum screen and an SMA input
parts.teach: dBm and dBV, RBW and noise floor, harmonics, hum, ripple, carriers

parts.name: True-RMS voltmeter
parts.sim: 10 MΩ floating input; AC+DC rms, AC rms, DC, dBV, dBm (600 Ω), Hz, duty over a 0.2 s gate
parts.look: bench box with a seven-segment readout
parts.teach: true RMS vs average-reading, crest factor, dB units

parts.name: LCR meter
parts.sim: small-signal AC solve with 1 V through 100 Ω at 100 Hz–100 kHz: |Z|, θ, Ls/Cs/Rs, Lp/Cp/Rp, ESR, D, Q
parts.look: bench box with a readout and Kelvin-clip sockets
parts.teach: impedance, reactance, series vs parallel models, ESR, D and Q

parts.name: Vector network analyzer
parts.sim: two 50 Ω ports; AC sweeps 10 Hz–6 GHz give S11 (return loss, VSWR, Zin, Smith chart) and S21 (or V2/V1 with a high-Z port 2)
parts.look: dark box with a Smith-chart screen and two SMA ports
parts.teach: reflection, matching, VSWR, Smith chart, filter transfer functions

parts.name: RF power meter (diode sensor)
parts.sim: 50 Ω sensor, −30…+20 dBm (+23 dBm damage), average power from a cable or an antenna via the link model; attenuator offset
parts.look: bench box with a dBm readout and an SMA sensor input
parts.teach: dBm and mW, attenuators, transmitter power

parts.name: Noise / hum / ripple source
parts.sim: VCVS OUT = IN + interference behind 50 Ω: Gaussian white noise (set bandwidth), 60/50 Hz hum with 3rd/5th harmonics, switching ripple (triangle + edge spikes)
parts.look: bench box showing a noisy trace
parts.teach: interference, signal-to-noise, why filters and shielding matter

parts.name: Ferrite bead (600 Ω @ 100 MHz)
parts.sim: Rdc + (R ∥ L) in time, ∥ C in AC: inductive below ≈ 30 MHz, resistive 30–500 MHz; current rating checked
parts.look: dark grey bead on a wire
parts.teach: EMI suppression, lossy vs reactive filtering, decoupling

parts.name: Common-mode choke (2 × 10 mH)
parts.sim: two coupled inductors (k = 0.995, inverse-inductance companion): differential signal sees the leakage, common-mode noise the full L
parts.look: black toroid with two copper windings straddling the channel
parts.teach: common vs differential mode, mutual inductance

parts.name: EMI π filter module (C-L-C)
parts.sim: R-C and R-L branches with ESR and DCR (10 µF – 10 µH – 10 µF, f₀ ≈ 16 kHz, −60 dB/dec); inductor saturation and capacitor voltage checked
parts.look: small blue PCB with two ceramic caps and a power inductor

parts.name: LC low-pass module
parts.sim: series L (with DCR) and shunt C (with ESR), second order, −40 dB/dec, peaks at f₀ when lightly loaded
parts.look: small blue PCB with an inductor and a capacitor
parts.teach: second-order filters, resonance, Q and damping

parts.name: USRP B210 software-defined radio
parts.sim: link-level SDR: CW tone on TX/RX A up to +10 dBm; RX2 A/B show carriers from the link model over kT·B·NF (NF 8 dB); 70 MHz–6 GHz, 56 MHz; damage above 0 dBm input (−15 dBm working max)
parts.look: dark ribbed enclosure with four gold SMA ports and status LEDs
parts.teach: SDR, spectrum, gain staging, input power limits

parts.name: nRF24L01+ 2.4 GHz radio
parts.sim: link level: channel, 0/−6/−12/−18 dBm, sensitivity −94/−85/−82 dBm at 250k/1M/2M; VCC 3.6 V abs max (5 V burns it); SPI not emulated
parts.look: green module with a 2×4 header and a meander PCB antenna
parts.teach: link budget, data rate vs range, 3.3 V supplies

parts.name: HC-05 Bluetooth serial module
parts.sim: two modules (master + slave) form a wireless UART: RXD of one appears on TXD of the other while the link closes (+4 dBm, −80 dBm); STATE high when linked
parts.look: blue breakout with a green radio board and a 6-pin header

parts.name: RFM95W LoRa radio (SX1276)
parts.sim: link level: 868/915 MHz, +2…+20 dBm, SF7–SF12 sensitivity −123…−136 dBm (125 kHz), decodes below the noise floor; 3.9 V abs max
parts.look: dark breakout with a metal shield can and a wire whip
parts.teach: spread spectrum, sensitivity vs SNR, long-range links

parts.name: 433 MHz ASK transmitter (FS1000A)
parts.sim: carrier on while DATA is high; ≈ +10 dBm at 12 V, ≈ +2 dBm at 5 V; λ/4 whip, bare pad or external antenna
parts.look: small green board with a SAW resonator and a 17 cm wire whip

parts.name: 433 MHz ASK receiver (XY-MK-5V)
parts.sim: DATA follows the carrier above −105 dBm (bit errors near the edge); with no carrier for 20 ms it chatters like a real super-regenerative receiver
parts.look: long green board with a coil, a trimmer and a wire whip
parts.teach: receivers, sensitivity, why decoders need a preamble

parts.name: Half-wave dipole antenna
parts.sim: 2.15 dBi, exact λ/2 pattern, linear along the arms, series-RLC Zin (73 Ω at f₀ = 0.95·c/2L); tilt and quarter-turn rotation set its orientation
parts.look: two thin arms on a stand with an SMA feed
parts.teach: resonance, length vs frequency, polarization, VSWR

parts.name: Quarter-wave monopole / whip
parts.sim: ≈ 3 dBi over 4 radials (5.15 dBi ideal), 36.5 Ω, f₀ = 0.95·c/4L
parts.look: vertical whip with four drooping radials

parts.name: Rubber-duck antenna (SMA)
parts.sim: ≈ 2 dBi, 50 Ω, vertical, set band
parts.look: black whip on a gold SMA plug

parts.name: Patch antenna
parts.sim: ≈ 7 dBi, 70° beam, 18 dB front-to-back, narrow band (Q 30)
parts.look: square copper patch on a green FR-4 ground plane, standing up

parts.name: Yagi-Uda antenna
parts.sim: 3 el. ≈ 7.5 dBi … 12 el. ≈ 13.5 dBi, beam 66°→33°, linear along the elements
parts.look: boom with a reflector, a driven element and directors

parts.name: Helical antenna (axial mode)
parts.sim: ≈ 11 dBi, 40° beam, right-hand circular: −3 dB to any linear antenna, cross-pol floor to LHCP
parts.look: copper helix over a round ground plate

parts.name: Small loop antenna
parts.sim: magnetic-dipole pattern (max in the loop plane), ≈ −8 dBi (η ≈ 10 %), very narrow band (Q 60)
parts.look: copper ring with a tuning capacitor on a stand

parts.name: Horn antenna
parts.sim: ≈ 15 dBi standard-gain horn (WR-187 band), 30° beam, 25 dB front-to-back
parts.look: flared metal horn on a waveguide adapter

parts.name: PCB inverted-F antenna
parts.sim: ≈ 2 dBi quasi-omni, mixed polarization (−3 dB flat), 50 Ω, 2.4 GHz
parts.look: small upright board with an F-shaped copper trace
